Q: Which one of the following countries has been suffering from decades of civil strife and food shorta
→ Zimbabwe has faced decades of civil strife and food shortages. The Maputo Accord for National Unity and Reconciliation was signed in Zimbabwe's context. Answer per UPSC key.
Q: In the recent years Chad, Guinea, Mali and Sudan caught the international attention for which one of
→ Chad, Guinea, Mali, and Sudan all experienced military coups and were suspended from the African Union in recent years. The answer per UPSC key relates to their common political instability — all had coups between 2019-2

fixes.fix: Explained "What do you know about Carolina TopCats Cheerleaders?"
fixes.text:
VERDICT: The Carolina TopCats Cheerleaders are the official cheerleading squad of the NFL's Carolina Panthers.
WHY: This team represents the franchise in game-day entertainment and community events, distinct from squads like the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders.
TRAPS: Do not confuse them with college squads (like UNC) or other NFL teams; 'TopCats' is specific to the Panthers only.
HOOK: Remember the name 'TopCats' links directly to the 'Panthers' brand—no other team uses this name. Exam trap: Questi

fixes.fix: Explained "In _____, the TopCats became the first cheerleading team of the National Football League t"
fixes.text:
VERDICT: The blank is filled by 2022.
WHY: In this year, the TopCats made history as the first NFL cheerleading squad to hire an openly transgender member, marking a significant milestone in sports inclusivity.
TRAPS: Do not confuse this with earlier diversity hires or non-NFL teams; the key is 'first' and 'NFL'.
HOOK: Remember the image of a diverse locker room celebrating unity. Exam trap: Questions often mix up years of major social milestones; stick to the specific event's documented date.
